sources.title: Risks and Returns of Cryptocurrency
sources.claim: Crypto returns exhibit strong time-series momentum and investor-attention predictability.
sources.limitations: Broad crypto-return evidence; not direct BingX strategy proof.

sources.title: Intraday Return Predictability in the Cryptocurrency Markets: Momentum, Reversal, or Both
sources.authors: Zhuzhu Wen; Elie Bouri; Yahua Xu; Yang Zhao
sources.claim: Intraday momentum and reversal coexist and depend on jumps, liquidity and event regimes.
sources.limitations: Historical high-frequency study; current costs require replay.

sources.title: Perpetual Futures and Basis Risk: Evidence from Cryptocurrency
sources.authors: Will Gornall; Martin Rinaldi; Yizhou Xiao
sources.claim: Constrained arbitrage and speculative demand create futures-basis dislocations and funding-mediated correction dynamics.

sources.title: High-Frequency Jump Analysis of the Bitcoin Market
sources.authors: Olivier Scaillet; Adrien Treccani; Christopher Trevisan
sources.claim: Order-flow imbalance, aggressive trading and spread widening relate to Bitcoin jumps and persistence.

sources.title: The Price Impact of Order Book Events
sources.authors: Rama Cont; Arseniy Kukanov; Sasha Stoikov
sources.claim: Short-horizon price changes relate strongly to order-flow imbalance and inversely to depth.

sources.title: Backtest overfitting - in-sample vs out-of-sample
sources.claim: Preserve true holdouts and bound redesign cycles.

sources.title: Minimum viable holding period given transaction costs
sources.claim: Natural signal horizon must dominate transaction-cost budget.

sources.title: Live strategy discussion
sources.claim: Practitioners emphasize uncorrelated strategies, execution-cost reduction and avoiding excessive retuning.

sources.title: Order Flow Trading System v6
sources.claim: Condition flow signals on trend/range/volatile/illiquid regimes.

sources.title: BTC W1 Mean Reversion
sources.claim: Weekly-range sweep/reclaim is a slower-horizon mean-reversion hypothesis.

sources.title: The profitability of technical trading rules in the Bitcoin market
sources.claim: Trading-range breakout showed forecasting power and strong Sharpe results, particularly in strongly trending Bitcoin regimes.
sources.limitations: Historical daily spot data; current perpetual costs must be replayed.

sources.title: Are simple technical trading rules profitable in bitcoin markets?
sources.claim: After transaction costs and multiple-hypothesis controls, selected technical-rule portfolios can retain out-of-sample economic value.
sources.limitations: Different rule universe/venue; no direct BingX proof.

sources.title: Technical trading and cryptocurrencies
sources.claim: A broad test of almost 15,000 rules across major technical-rule classes reports predictability and profitability in several cryptocurrency markets.
sources.limitations: Historical spot markets; requires cost-adjusted local replication.

sources.title: The intraday dynamics and intraday price discovery of bitcoin
sources.claim: London-New York overlapping hours dominate Bitcoin price discovery while volume, volatility and liquidity are elevated.
sources.limitations: Spot study; perpetual implementation must be locally replayed.

sources.title: Time-of-day periodicities of trading volume and volatility in Bitcoin exchange
sources.claim: Bitcoin volume and volatility are higher during US/European daytime and on weekdays than weekends.
sources.limitations: Historical Bitstamp evidence; conditioning requires BingX replay.

sources.title: Up or down? Short-term reversal, momentum, and liquidity effects in cryptocurrency markets
sources.claim: Illiquid cryptoassets show stronger reversal, while the largest and most tradeable coins show daily momentum; liquidity can flip signal direction.
sources.limitations: Cross-sectional evidence needs BTC/ETH time-series adaptation.

sources.title: Anatomy of Cryptocurrency Perpetual Futures Returns
sources.claim: Among 170 basis, momentum, liquidity, size and volatility predictors, many significant perpetual-return sorts are reported; log-basis and a price-volume factor explain much of the structure.

sources.title: Funding Rate Mechanism in Perpetual Futures
sources.claim: Funding feedback can induce mean-reverting basis dynamics; update intervals, caps and liquidation/jump states change the path and tails.
sources.limitations: Model-based working paper; empirical local test mandatory.

sources.title: SMC & Order Flow Trading Strategy
sources.claim: Use aggressive-flow/volume context as an entry-selectivity hypothesis.
sources.limitations: Hypothesis only; popularity is not proof.

sources.title: How to Read and Use a Crypto Order Book
sources.claim: Order-book depth and bid/ask state are observable liquidity context.

sources.title: How to Use Order Flow for Trading Setups
sources.claim: Aggressive side and delta/volume-profile context can classify market control.

next_evidence_gap: Continue technically inspectable >=100K-view YouTube search, but never treat view count as economic proof. Primary literature now has priority over popularity.
